nav.label: Sections
login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Enter the console token. It is KODRA_CONSOLE_TOKEN in the agent's .env file, or in its Kubernetes Secret.
login.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
overview.title: Overview
connectors.title: Connectors
activity.title: Activity
activity.intro: Everything the agent did, from its audit log. Secrets are removed.
investigations.title: Investigations
investigations.intro: Alerts the agent looked into, read-only, and what it found.
usage.title: Usage
usage.intro: Tokens the agent used, from its audit log.
usage.priceSource: Cost is estimated from {source} list prices as of {date}.
usage.priceOverride: Cost is estimated from the prices in kodra-agent.yaml.
usage.noPrice: No price is known for {model}. Set spec.console.pricing in kodra-agent.yaml to see an estimated cost.
usage.cacheRate: {rate} of input tokens came from the cache.
usage.question: Question
approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.intro: Changes the agent asked for, and what an approver decided, here or in Slack.
connectors.usedByShip: Used by kodra-agent ship to build and test images. The model gets no tools from it.
connectors.usedForChat: Used for Slack messages and approvals. The model gets no tools from it.
chat.title: Chat
chat.queued: Waiting for a free slot. At most 2 questions run at once.
chat.offline: Lost the connection to the agent. Trying again.
chat.start: Ask a question below to start.
approval.confirm: Run {action} now? This changes your system.
approval.cannot: Waiting for an approver. Sign in with a console approver token to decide here.
approval.expired: This request expired. Nothing was run.
chat.policy: Reads run on their own. Changes wait for an approver.
chat.placeholderBusy: You can write your next message while it works
chat.stopHint: Stop ends this answer and keeps what it found so far. Nothing it was about to change runs.
chat.hint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line. Up to {n} characters.
chat.emptyIntro: I can read {connectors}. I ask an approver before I change anything.
chat.suggest.source: Which merge requests or pull requests are open?
chat.suggest.cicd: Did the last pipeline fail, and why?
chat.suggest.cloud: Are any alarms firing right now?
chat.suggest.monitoring: Which alerts are firing right now?
approval.runsExactly: Runs these steps exactly, and stops if a file changed since this preview.
pause.pausedBy: Paused by {who} at {time}. Reads and chat keep working; nothing is changed until an approver resumes.
overview.runningText: Reads run on their own. Changes wait for an approver. Pausing refuses every change until you resume; reads and chat keep working.
overview.review: Review them on the Approvals page.
overview.budgetShare: {share}% of the budget. Questions stop at 100%.
overview.budgetOver: The budget is used up. New questions are refused; alerts are still investigated.
overview.noBudget: No monthly budget set. An estimate from list prices.
